name: Fortree City
lines:
By being together with Pokémon,
people make more and more friends.
And that brings the world closer
together. I think it’s wonderful!

Heheh, I asked my Wingull to run an
errand for me.

Huh? What is this?
What is it holding?

A Mental Herb?
It must have picked it up somewhere.

But I’m not a Trainer, so you can
have it.

Thanks to my Wingull, I’m able to be
close to my friend who lives far away.
